## Functions

### `createRealmLocalOperatorPolicyAdapter(options)`

Read-only localOperatorPolicy@1 facade for one original B4A coherent cut and one actual issued lifecycle. The exact frozen host options are { operatorContextAdapter, lifecycleComposition }; the original B4A issuer must retain this exact composition. No equal-label substitute is accepted. readPolicy is synchronous: the original observation already verified the policy digest. The first valid request binds its actual issued generation, original work root and all six context fields. No storage read, observation refresh, generation allocation, or guessed epoch takes place here. Generic observation loss and issued-session retirement irreversibly stop this facade before service-stopped delivery. This does not assert which head changed. Host close only retires this facade; the original B4A observation, lifecycle composition, shared manager and signal roots remain their owners'.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
